name: mfc_three_float_dialog_on_create
description: MfcThreeFloatDialog::OnCreate returns -1 only when CWnd::Default returns -1, otherwise it returns 0.
known_limits: Binary Ninja assembly validates the Default()==-1 result rule and callee cleanup for the CREATESTRUCT pointer.
Tier S verification is deferred to a coherent MfcThreeFloatDialog/MFC-message-map pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4069f0 calls CWnd::Default and returns -1 for Default()==-1 and 0 otherwise.
The native smoke validates both Default return cases with a test double for the provider call and verifies the WM_CREATE message-map entry targets OnCreate.
